name: ui_request_redraw
notes: sets DS:6C4A=1, 8B92=-1, 8BAA=7D00h, clears 4736/4737, flushes key; see game_flow

name: music_stop
notes: stop current song, gate off, jukebox button label 'Catch some tunes'

name: music_resume
notes: resume current song if enabled and started, label 'Squelch it !'

name: music_start
notes: restart current song at base+2*word_off after delay+1 ticks

name: music_rewind
notes: stop and rewind; only caller is dead 0f38:6fec

name: drive_isr_install
notes: INT 8 = 0000:238c, ch2 divisor 1Eh, gate on if sound on

name: isr_drive
notes: INT 8 while driving: engine/siren/squeal sound + car physics (race)

name: song_select
type: void far (u16 off, u16 seg, u16 loop_tbl)
notes: 2e6b:0000 = back to background tune, else start loop sound on DS:79C6

name: vib_set
type: void far (int on, int row, int period, int depth, int step)

name: music_off_rewind
notes: vibrato off, gate off, 1a7c; no callers

name: music_mute
notes: 1 = stop music and remember (DS:58D8), 0 = resume if muted by us

name: snd_calibrate_delay
notes: delay(n) calls per BIOS tick, 3/4 if > 848

name: fx_burst
type: void near (int lo, int hi, int d, int n)

name: fx_sweep_down
type: void near (int from, int to, int step, int d)

name: fx_warble
type: void near (int c, int dev, int step, int d, int n)

name: pwm_up
type: void near (int period, int *duty, int n, int reps)
notes: software PWM on port 61h bit 1; dead

name: pwm_down
type: void near (int period, int *duty, int n, int reps)

name: ramp_fill
type: int near (int *buf, int from, int to, int step)

name: pwm_swell
type: void near (long hz, int period, int to, int step, int reps, int n)
notes: 30 kHz carrier + PWM swell; only from dead 775a/778a

name: fx_noise
type: void near (int range, int ormask, int n)
notes: gate off, n x (toggle bit 1, delay(rng(range)|ormask))

name: fx_noise_down
type: void near (int a, int b, int sub, int step, int n)

name: fx_noise_up
type: void near (int a, int b, int sub, int step, int n)

name: fx_crash
notes: 3 x (burst, noise down, noise, noise up)

name: fx_hit
notes: two bursts + noise: collisions while racing

name: pulse3_play
notes: 3-voice pulse-train player; no callers, no data

name: snd_enabled
notes: master sound switch, Ctrl toggles, init 1

name: music_cur
notes: near ptr to current SongState (79AA or 79C6)

name: music_enabled_saved
notes: 58D0 saved while a loop sound plays, -1 none

name: bg_loop_counts
notes: background tune extra plays per section, -1 end

name: bg_vib_index
notes: background tune vibrato record per section play

name: anim_mode
notes: 1 while animation player 0f38:8e48 runs (alt engine note); see video

name: anim_engine_ref
notes: subtracted from DS:825E for the engine note of the animation player 0f38:8e48 (0000:238c @245e); see video/garage
